verdict: The released HTP tokens are a valid non-collapsed reconstruction baseline but do not pass the Stage 1 semantic-primitive gate. Sampling consistency is below the provisional 0.70 layer-1 threshold in at least one city, and the model has no uncertainty mechanism. These results support testing P1–P4, not interpreting the released tokens as motion primitives.
